fieldValues.title: Retire the Key Invariants record and the section Type, closing srs#710 (RFC-042 Change B)
fieldValues.summary: Deleted the last section-typed record (Key Invariants, no successor needed) and the section Type definition. Redesigned injectKeyInvariants to generate its heading rather than find one, anchored on the unique Validation heading, and fixed a real spurious-insertion bug this redesign introduced before it was committed.
fieldValues.body:
Claimed 2026-09-11T~17:2xZ from srs#710's gate:dispatched via srs#580's queue, picking up the 17:16:26Z coordinator dispatch (unit 2, the closing unit).

Ground: fresh unshallowed worktree off origin/master (ebb6253, carries PR #760 — subsection Type already deleted). Confirmed 1 section record (Key Invariants, df42f888) and 0 subsection records. Key Invariants had zero outbound contains children (all moved out by earlier srs#710 batches), one inbound contains (from the Conformance Part concept, 42cf3443), and sat in a legacy flat precedes chain crossing Part boundaries: Extensions (580cfe0e) -> Key Invariants -> Extension Interactions (4d1fa8d8) -- a chain that does not correspond to current container-subset rendering order (Extensions/Extension Interactions are children of a different Part, 159ae3c2, not of Conformance). Per carried-context-7668a275, spliced precedes directly Extensions -> Extension Interactions before deleting, regardless of whether the old chain was actually load-bearing for rendering. Per carried-context-c4e43a58, grepped every RFC's srs-integration manifest for a section:key-invariants token -- zero hits.

keyInvariantsExemptTitleCounts confirmed empirically empty even before deletion (record delete --cascade's own cascadedRelations report showed zero outbound contains from df42f888), matching the dissolve case rather than the retype case: no successor record was created, since the record's own authored content field ("Conforming implementations must uphold the following invariants.") was already byte-identical to renderInvariants()'s own first generated line and was discarded on every prior injection anyway.

The actual work: invariant-region.mjs's injectKeyInvariants could no longer find a "Key Invariants" heading (nothing authors it once the record is gone), so it now generates the heading itself. Anchored it immediately before the "Validation" concept heading -- confirmed, by rendering the raw composition before making any change, that Key Invariants was Validation's immediate predecessor sibling under Conformance in both srs-spec.md and srs-unified.md's pre-injection output, and that "Validation" is a unique heading text in each raw render. Reconstructed the exact byte sequence of the old splice (heading + \n\n + content.trimEnd() + \n\n + next heading) so the committed exports would come out byte-identical -- confirmed via a full publish-spec.mjs run: zero diff on docs/spec/srs-spec.md and srs-unified.md.

Found a real bug before committing: an unscoped first draft called injectKeyInvariants for every VIEW_EXPORTS entry (as the old code always had, relying on "Key Invariants" being incidentally globally unique). "Validation" is not globally unique -- srs-glossary.md also renders a "Validation" entry (its concept-glossary composition lists concepts alphabetically) -- so the unscoped draft spliced a spurious Key Invariants block into srs-glossary.md, caught only by manually reading the publish-spec.mjs git diff (+319 lines, all additions) rather than by any automated check: check-release-drift.mjs is self-consistent with whatever publish-spec.mjs just wrote, and checkPublishCompleteness only detects lost headings, never spurious ones. Fixed by scoping both call sites (publish-spec.mjs's injectInvariants, check-release-drift.mjs's applyInvariantInjection) to entry.requiresKeyInvariants. Proved the fix live: reverted the scoping in check-release-drift.mjs alone, re-ran it against the clean committed docs/, and got FAILED: rendered document drift: .../srs-glossary.md is stale -- re-render to update (exit 1); reverted, re-ran green (exit 0). Filed as finding-<see related>.

Also fixed keyInvariantsExemptTitleCounts (publish-completeness.mjs) to return an empty Map instead of throwing once no section-typed Key Invariants record exists -- it throws today whenever it can't find that record, which is now permanent and by design rather than a transient migration state.

Deleted the section Type via srs type delete once record count hit zero. Bumped spec-authoring-core 2.0.0 -> 3.0.0 (breaking Type removal), matching the 1.1.0 -> 2.0.0 precedent PR #760 set for subsection. Left check-spec-coherence.mjs's LEAF_TYPES set and the 0-live-relation section-sequence relation type untouched, out of scope, matching #760's identical treatment of subsection-sequence.

Both gates verified green by direct exit code on the pinned CLI (v0.1.0-build.376), unshallowed worktree: validate-all.mjs and check-release-drift.mjs (including the srs#396 publish-completeness guard and its own sabotage self-test).

Running tally under rfc-decision-1e7c0c8e / rfc-decision-5f8204bc: 65/65 subsection + 1/1 section = 75/75 records retired, both Types deleted. RFC-042 Change B's section/subsection retirement is complete.

PR: https://github.com/the-greenman/srs/pull/761, gate:auto-merge armed (SQUASH). Stopping per the merge-rights contract.
